monitoring.recalibration_trigger: any RED, or AMBER on two consecutive monthly runs

monte_carlo.note: EaR = base-path NII minus the (1-p) percentile of simulated NII; positive = shortfall. Illustrative bank.

driver_regressions.note: NII ratio and the policy rate are persistent (see stationarity); the levels R2 can be inflated by common trends, so the 4-quarter-difference specification is the cleaner estimate of the short-run rate/slope sensitivity.

usnim_validation.explanation: USNIM divides NII by earning assets; ours divides by total assets (incl. cash-like, fixed and non-earning assets), so ours is lower by roughly the earning-asset share.
